'''2014 Worlds Day 3 Matthew Harrison-Trainor DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 3).

2013 Players Committee sheet, mostly typed, name MHT, deck name Walkers. Line 44 (Control + SFS) and line 59 (Surprise crossed out) are blank for a later read. Line 45 is I Had No Choice (Crash Landing crossed out).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
